description:
Advances: ancora.review

Severity: High (calibrated). BLOCKS THE EPIC PR.

Concrete failure: mix spec.check --base ecc5e24 exits non-zero with spec.check result=fail tier=branch errors=0 warnings=1. CI smoke runs mix spec.check --base origin/BASE_REF with no continue-on-error, which for a PR into main is that identical command, so the PR is red on 100 percent of runs.

Cause, not a tool bug: .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md changed by exactly one line across all 37 branch commits, status draft to status active. That is spec-meta, which ancora.derive.acknowledgment_is_substantive correctly refuses to count as acknowledgment, while about 1000 lines of review code landed under that untouched contract.

Fix lands ON this branch before the PR. Tracked as a work order because the orchestrator does not author spec contracts; this needs an implementer plus a cold verifier per the epic discipline.

Found by /ship-it preflight, critical review 2026-09-03, finding F1. Verified by execution twice.

comments.text:
Full detail from the /ship-it preflight.

Verbatim gate output at 5220686 (env-pinned 27.2 / 1.18.1-otp-27):

  [WARNING] ancora.review derived/growth - :: ancora.review: tests now call new functions: Ancora.Markdown.render/1, Ancora.Markdown.render/2, Ancora.Review.FindingsDelta.classify/2, Ancora.Review.FindingsDelta.classify/3, Ancora.Review.Html.render/1, Ancora.Review.build/2, Mix.Tasks.Spec.Review.run/1 - acknowledge them in the spec for this subject
  checked subjects=7 requirements=82 errors=0 warnings=1
  branch base=ecc5e24 changed_files=175 findings=39 (error=0 warning=1 info=38, info hidden)
  branch next=edit the affected spec or production code
  spec.check result=fail tier=branch errors=0 warnings=1
  ** (Mix) spec.check failed

The CI command it maps to (.github/workflows/ci.yml, smoke step):
  base_ref="${PR_BASE_REF:-$DEFAULT_BRANCH}"
  git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$base_ref"
  mix spec.check --base "origin/$base_ref"
For a PR into main, base_ref=main and origin/main will be ecc5e24, so CI runs the exact failing command.

Why the epic never caught this: every per-ticket gate ran --base against a recent incremental base (26e3100 and similar), never against the actual PR base. Six of seven subjects received substantive requirement or scenario edits during the epic and cleared their growth findings; ancora.review is the only subject whose contract went untouched while its implementation landed.

Deliverable: a substantive requirement/scenario pass over .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md describing what actually shipped, covering the seven bindings above. NOT a Spec-Ack: trailer and NOT a config demotion - ancora.decision.slimmed_governance scopes trailers to mass mechanical edits, and this is the opposite case (real new surface, genuinely undescribed).

Verification:
- env ASDF_ERLANG_VERSION=27.2 ASDF_ELIXIR_VERSION=1.18.1-otp-27 mix spec.check --base ecc5e24  ends spec.check result=pass
- mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- full suite green on both CI matrix legs (1.18.4/OTP 26.2.5 and 1.19.5/OTP 28.3.1)

Sequencing: consolidated finding F41 (delete dead SpecDiff.compute/3, parse_source/1, FindingsDelta.compute/3 and the binary clause of classify/3) changes the function set ancora.review tagged tests call. Sequence F41 after this spec pass, or fold both into one change.

Allowed touches: .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md, plus .spec/decisions/** only if an ADR is genuinely required.
Out of scope: weakening the acknowledgment mechanism; behavior changes under lib/ancora/review/**.

Consolidated report: /Users/mz/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/ancora/2026-09-03/ancora-yzu-spec-anchored-successor/20260903-052243-consolidated.md

title: Acknowledge the shipped ancora.review surface so the gate passes against main
